about.title: About Levant Co.
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner in authentic gold trading since 2020
about.storyParagraph1: Levant Co. was founded with a simple yet powerful vision: to create a transparent and trustworthy platform for buying authentic gold products. We recognized the challenges customers face in verifying gold authenticity and finding reliable sellers.
about.storyParagraph2: Our platform brings together verified gold shops and discerning customers, creating a marketplace built on trust, quality, and transparency. Every shop on our platform undergoes rigorous verification to ensure they meet our high standards.
about.storyParagraph3: Today, we're proud to serve thousands of satisfied customers, offering them access to premium gold products with complete peace of mind. Our commitment to authenticity and customer satisfaction remains at the heart of everything we do.
about.missionDescription: To provide a secure, transparent platform that connects customers with verified gold sellers, ensuring authenticity, fair pricing, and exceptional service at every step of the journey.
about.visionDescription: To become the world's most trusted gold marketplace, where authenticity is guaranteed, prices are transparent, and every transaction is built on trust.
about.coreValuesSubtitle: The principles that guide everything we do
about.valueAuthenticityDesc: Every product is verified and certified to ensure 100% authenticity
about.valueQualityDesc: We partner only with premium gold sellers who meet our strict standards
about.valueTrustDesc: Building lasting relationships through transparency and reliability
about.valueTransparencyDesc: Clear pricing with live gold rates and no hidden fees
about.reason1Desc: Every shop on our platform is thoroughly vetted and verified. We ensure they meet our strict standards for authenticity, quality, and service.
about.reason2Desc: Our prices are based on real-time gold rates, updated continuously. You always know you're getting fair, transparent pricing.
about.reason3Desc: Your safety is our priority. We use industry-leading security measures to protect your personal information and financial data.
about.reason4Desc: Our dedicated customer support team is here to help you 24/7. Whether you have questions or need assistance, we're always available.
about.founderDescription: Ibrahim Alnezami is the founder and lead developer of Levant Co. With a passion for building modern, scalable applications, Ibrahim created this platform to revolutionize the gold trading industry through technology and transparency.
about.ctaDescription: Join thousands of satisfied customers who trust Levant Co. for their gold purchases

help.title: How Can We Help?
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or get in touch with our support team
help.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to questions you may have
help.noResultsFound: No results found. Try a different search term.
help.faq1Question: How do I place an order?
help.faq1Answer: To place an order, browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll need to create an account or sign in, provide shipping information, and complete payment.
help.faq2Question: What payment methods do you accept?
help.faq2Answer: We accept major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), debit cards, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely through our encrypted payment gateway.
help.faq3Answer: Shipping typically takes 3-5 business days for domestic orders and 7-14 business days for international orders. You'll receive a tracking number once your order ships.
help.faq4Question: Can I return or exchange a product?
help.faq4Answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day return policy for most products. Items must be in their original condition with all certificates and packaging. Contact our support team to initiate a return.
help.faq5Question: How do I verify gold authenticity?
help.faq5Answer: All our products come with authenticity certificates from verified sellers. Each item is tested and certified for its gold content and purity. You can verify certificates through our platform.
help.faq6Answer: Absolutely. We use industry-standard SSL encryption and secure payment gateways. We never store your complete credit card information on our servers.
help.faq7Question: How do I track my order?
help.faq7Answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can also view your order status by logging into your account and visiting the Orders page.
help.faq8Question: What if I receive a damaged product?
help.faq8Answer: If you receive a damaged product, contact us immediately with photos. We'll arrange for a return and provide a full refund or replacement at no additional cost.
help.contactSupport: Our support team is here to assist you
